req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[5] having kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. The rule requires that a negative kind test must not use the STC heuristic (STC is reserved for state-transition coverage which is a structural/positive heuristic). Fix: change test[5] heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG', which correctly classifies a negative test that verifies a deleted resource returns 404. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200_with_correct_payload
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
Task id=1 has title 'Read chapter 5' and completed=true
trace: R-TASK-009: positive path — existing id must not trigger 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200_with_correct_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body["completed"] == True
    assert "created_at" in body

tests.name: test_get_deleted_task_returns_404
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
actions: Send DELETE /tasks/10 to remove the task
Send GET /tasks/10 to verify it is gone
trace: R-TASK-009: negative — task that has been deleted must return 404 on subsequent GET
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_get_deleted_task_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    del_r = client.delete("/tasks/10")
    assert del_r.status_code == 204
    get_r = client.get("/tasks/10")
    assert get_r.status_code == 404
    body = get_r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert "10" in body["detail"]

tests.name: test_get_task_status_code_is_exactly_404_not_400_or_500
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
actions: Assert status code is exactly 404 (not 400, not 500, not 200)
trace: R-TASK-009: decision table — only 404 is acceptable for unknown id; catches status-code constant mutations
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_get_task_status_code_is_exactly_404_not_400_or_500():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/100")
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code != 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert "100" in body["detail"]
